title: API Request & Response Middleware
summary: This module provides middleware for processing and transforming incoming API requests (Anthropic, OpenAI) into an internal format, handling features like web search integration, and formatting responses. It acts as a crucial translation and extension layer for the API.

nodes.label: Receive Client Request
nodes.title: Client API Request
nodes.description: Represents an incoming API request from a client, typically in Anthropic or OpenAI format.

nodes.label: Decompress Zstd Body
nodes.title: Zstd Decompression
nodes.description: Decompresses incoming request bodies if the 'Content-Encoding: zstd' header is present, preparing them for further processing by API adapters.

nodes.label: Adapt Anthropic Request
nodes.title: Anthropic Request Adapter
nodes.description: Transforms incoming Anthropic API requests into the internal API format, handling message structures, options, and tool definitions for chat interactions.

nodes.label: Adapt OpenAI Chat Request
nodes.title: OpenAI Chat Adapter
nodes.description: Transforms incoming OpenAI Chat API requests into the internal API format, including complex message content, embedded images, and tool calls.

nodes.label: Adapt OpenAI Completions Request
nodes.title: OpenAI Completions Adapter
nodes.description: Transforms incoming OpenAI Completions API requests into the internal API format, mapping prompt, generation options, and streaming preferences.

nodes.label: Adapt OpenAI Embeddings Request
nodes.title: OpenAI Embeddings Adapter
nodes.description: Transforms incoming OpenAI Embeddings API requests into the internal API format, supporting single or batch inputs and various encoding formats.

nodes.label: Adapt OpenAI Image Edits Request
nodes.title: OpenAI Image Edits Adapter
nodes.description: Transforms incoming OpenAI Image Edits API requests, extracting image data and the editing prompt for internal image manipulation processing.

nodes.label: Adapt OpenAI Image Gen Request
nodes.title: OpenAI Image Gen Adapter
nodes.description: Transforms incoming OpenAI Image Generations API requests, extracting the prompt and desired image dimensions for internal image creation.

nodes.label: Enforce Cloud Model Access
nodes.title: Cloud Model Access Control
nodes.description: Enforces policies and checks authorization for using cloud-based models, especially when integrated with features like web search.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Web Search Tool
nodes.title: Web Search Orchestrator
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle of web search tool calls, including initiating searches, processing external results, and handling multi-iteration loops with the model.

nodes.label: External Web Search API
nodes.title: External Web Search
nodes.description: An external API or service responsible for performing actual web searches and returning structured results to the orchestrator.

nodes.label: Process Internal API Request
nodes.title: Internal API Handler
nodes.description: The core API handler module that processes the transformed request using internal model server capabilities and generates a raw response.

nodes.label: Internal Model Runtime
nodes.title: Internal Model Server
nodes.description: The backend system responsible for running and scheduling various models, executing generation, embedding, or other AI tasks.

nodes.label: Write API Response
nodes.title: API Response Writer
nodes.description: Writes the final, formatted API response back to the client, managing both streaming (Server-Sent Events) and non-streaming data transmission.

nodes.label: Collect Usage Metrics
nodes.title: Usage Metrics Collector
nodes.description: Aggregates and records token usage, evaluation counts, and other performance metrics from both model interactions and tool executions.

nodes.label: Send Client Response
nodes.title: Client API Response
nodes.description: The final API response sent back to the client, adhering to the requested Anthropic or OpenAI format.

nodes.label: Format Error Response
nodes.title: Error Response Formatter
nodes.description: Formats internal errors and exceptions into client-friendly API error responses, ensuring consistent error reporting across the API.

nodes.label: Set Relax Thinking Flag
nodes.title: Relax Thinking Flag Setter
nodes.description: Sets a specific flag in the request context to modify or relax thinking constraints for certain Anthropic-style chat requests.

nodes.label: Format Anthropic Response
nodes.title: Anthropic Response Formatter
nodes.description: Formats internal API responses into Anthropic-compatible message structures, including content blocks, tool results, and usage information.

nodes.label: Format OpenAI Response
nodes.title: OpenAI Response Formatter
nodes.description: Formats internal API responses into OpenAI-compatible structures for chat, completions, embeddings, and image operations, including usage data.

edges.label: Checks cloud model access for web search
Provides web search results for formatting

groups.label: Request Ingestion & Preprocessing
groups.title: Request Ingestion & Preprocessing
groups.description: Handles the initial reception of client requests and performs any necessary preprocessing like decompression.

groups.label: API Adapters
groups.title: API Adapters
groups.description: Transforms incoming requests from various external API formats (Anthropic, OpenAI) into a standardized internal API request structure.

groups.label: Tooling & Orchestration
groups.title: Tooling & Orchestration
groups.description: Manages specific API features and external tool integrations, such as web search and access control for cloud models.

groups.label: Core Processing (External)
groups.title: Core Processing (External)
groups.description: Represents the interaction with the main internal API handler and external services like the web search API and model runtime.

groups.label: Response Generation & Postprocessing
groups.title: Response Generation & Postprocessing
groups.description: Handles the formatting of internal responses back into client-specific API formats, collects usage metrics, and manages error reporting.
